text: Öznur has loved her cousin Kudret since childhood, and for a while she turns his head, until he [chooses his happy marriage to Nisa|trigger|being spurned or shamed]. Overcome by a forbidden passion and determined to [make him hers|wants|a lover to possess], she [turns to black magic|origin|deliberately called up], and the spell sets jinn upon Nisa. By the talisman's terms, once [five night prayers have passed|rules|death on a deadline], Nisa and [everyone of her blood|who_suffers|heirs of old wrongs] will meet death.
